name: etree-indent-settings
instr:
I'm restoring configurable XML indentation in our copy of `github.com/beevik/etree`. The repository is in `/app`; unfinished functions in `etree.go` currently panic. Could you implement `Document.IndentWithSettings` and the other stubbed indentation, document and element operations so callers can build, edit and format XML trees?

Use the API doc comments and the "Creating an XML document" section of `README.md` as the contract. Preserve the existing element indentation helpers' leaf whitespace behavior. `SetTail` must insert text when no tail exists and clear existing tail text for an empty argument. `Element.Copy` must recursively copy every child token kind and give the copy its own attribute storage. `CreateChild` has `CreateElement`'s tag and attachment behavior, calls the continuation on the new child, and returns it.

Keep exported names and signatures unchanged. Use package variables for initialization rather than new `init` functions. I'll check the restored APIs and existing package behavior with the package tests.

In added non-test Go code, avoid: new `init()` functions; imports of `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys/unix`, `golang.org/x/sys/windows`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing`, `flag` or cgo; dot imports of `os`, `runtime`, `runtime/debug` or `log`; `//go:linkname`, `//go:embed`, `//line` or `/*line` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess`, `runtime.Goexit`, `os.Args`, `os.Exec
